comments.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, can you make sure all your commits are signed and verified in this repo too? 

You can  `git config --global commit.gpgsign true` and set `gpg.format ssh` with `user.signingkey` pointing to the key used on [#PostHog-js/5355](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog-js/pull/5353).
Thanks @turnipdabeets, the commits on this branch are now signed and show as verified (same content, re-signed only).
